text: Take your rosary tonight and place it under your pillow before you sleep. Tomorrow morning you will understand why. This is one of the oldest practices among people of faith, simple, silent and powerful. Before you go to bed, hold the rosary with both hands. You do not need to pray right now. Just hold it, close your eyes and say quietly, While I rest, may I be protected. May what is heavy be carried away. May I wake up lighter than when I lay down. Place it under your pillow and sleep. Now pay attention to what happens in the morning. If you wake up with a sense of peace you were not expecting, your heart was needing that shelter. There is something you have been carrying alone for too long, and that night you finally did not carry it alone. If you dream of people who have already passed, your mother, someone you loved, they came because they were cold, it is not coincidence, it is an answer. If you wake up wanting to pray, to light a candle, to give thanks, it is a sign that something moved during the night. Your soul asked and it was heard. Whatever happens, do not speak about what you felt before your morning coffee. Keep it to yourself. What happens in that morning? Silence belongs only to you. Think about how many nights you went to bed with a heavy heart and had nothing to hold on to. Write in the comments, Amen if you are going to do this tonight. And if you feel that one night is not enough, that what you carry inside has been weighing on you for far too long, and you need to learn how to truly release it to find a peace that does not depend on anything or anyone. I spent over twenty years learning in silence how to do exactly that, and everything I know is inside The Way Back to Stillness. The link is in my profile.
